import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

runtime = Path("src/do_again/browser/runtime.py")
browser_init = Path("src/do_again/browser/__init__.py")
test_browser = Path("tests/test_browser.py")

r = runtime.read_text()
start = r.index("@_project_operation\ndef notify_receipts")
end = r.index("@_project_operation\ndef notify_receipt", start)

replacement = '''@_project_operation
def notify_receipts(repo: Path, receipts: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not receipts:
        return {"response": "nothing_to_deliver", "chat_url": ""}

    record = project_record(repo)
    chat_url = str(record.get("chat_url") or "")
    if not chat_url:
        raise BrowserError("project has no bound automation chat; run do-again setup")

    rows: list[str] = []
    ids: list[str] = []
    for receipt in receipts:
        request_id = str(receipt.get("request_id") or "")
        state = str(receipt.get("state") or "")
        ids.append(request_id)
        rows.append(
            f"- {request_id} state={state} "
            f"path=automation/do_again/receipts/{request_id}.json"
        )

    batch_marker = "DO_AGAIN_RECEIPTS_READY request_ids=" + ",".join(ids)
    message = (
        batch_marker
        + ". Inspect these receipts on "
        + str(record.get("control_branch", "operator-control"))
        + " in order, continue the existing goal once across the batch, and use another scoped "
        + "Do Again request only if more local work is needed:\\n"
        + "\\n".join(rows)
    )

    status = ensure_browser_running(verify_auth=True)
    port = int(status["port"])
    target = _find_chatgpt_target(port, chat_url)
    if target is None:
        target = cdp.create_target(port, chat_url, background=True)

    warning = _context_limit_warning(target)
    if warning:
        if _assistant_snapshot(target).get("busy"):
            raise BrowserError(
                "context limit detected while ChatGPT is still busy; retrying later"
            )
        target, record = _rollover_project_chat(
            repo,
            record,
            port=port,
            old_target=target,
        )

    target, _ = wait_for_authenticated(
        port,
        chat_url=record["chat_url"],
        timeout=30.0,
        target=target,
    )
    if _assistant_snapshot(target).get("busy"):
        raise BrowserError("ChatGPT is still generating; retry delivery later")

    if _page_contains(target, batch_marker):
        return {"response": "already_delivered", "chat_url": target.url}

    try:
        return send_message(
            target,
            message,
            timeout=180.0,
            wait_for_response=False,
        )
    except BrowserError:
        warning = _context_limit_warning(target)
        if not warning or _assistant_snapshot(target).get("busy"):
            raise
        target, _ = _rollover_project_chat(
            repo,
            project_record(repo),
            port=port,
            old_target=target,
        )
        if _page_contains(target, batch_marker):
            return {"response": "already_delivered", "chat_url": target.url}
        return send_message(
            target,
            message,
            timeout=180.0,
            wait_for_response=False,
        )


'''
runtime.write_text(r[:start] + replacement + r[end:])

bi = browser_init.read_text()
if "notify_receipts" not in bi:
    bi = bi.replace("    notify_receipt,\n", "    notify_receipt,\n    notify_receipts,\n", 1)
    if "__all__" in bi and '"notify_receipt",' in bi:
        bi = bi.replace('    "notify_receipt",\n', '    "notify_receipt",\n    "notify_receipts",\n', 1)
browser_init.write_text(bi)

tb = test_browser.read_text()
if "notify_receipts" not in tb.split("\n", 40)[0:40]:
    if "from do_again.browser.runtime import (" in tb:
        tb = tb.replace("    notify_receipt,\n", "    notify_receipt,\n    notify_receipts,\n", 1)
test_browser.write_text(tb)

subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "py_compile", "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py", "src/do_again/service/daemon.py"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)

subprocess.run([
    "git", "add",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    "tests/test_browser.py",
    "tests/test_daemon.py",
], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Batch browser receipt notifications"], check=True)

push = subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"])
if push.returncode != 0:
    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "origin", "main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "rebase", "origin/main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)

print("HEAD=" + subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("STATUS=")
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--short"], text=True))
